hero.title: About InnovoGrow
hero.lead: Engineering smarter light distribution for commercial growers.
hero.description: We design and deliver high-performance LED grow lighting solutions that drive consistent results, lower operating costs, and help cultivators grow better at every scale.

story.title: Born in the Grow Room. Built for What Matters.
paragraphs: InnovoGrow was founded by growers and engineers who saw a better way to do lighting. We set out to solve the real challenges commercial cultivators face - heat, inefficiency, uneven coverage, and rising costs - by rethinking light distribution at the source.
Today, our solutions are trusted by cultivators across North America and beyond, from boutique facilities to large-scale commercial operations.

sideCards.title: Mission
sideCards.text: Deliver innovative LED lighting solutions that maximize yield, efficiency, and profitability for commercial growers.

sideCards.title: Vision
sideCards.text: A future where every grower has the smarter light they need to cultivate a better world.

items.text: Founded by cultivators and engineers with a shared vision.
Launched our first commercial LED fixture line.
Expanded product portfolio with top-light-led room strategies and targeted support fixtures.
Opened our engineering and test facility to drive innovation and rigor.
Grew our U.S. distribution network and partner program.
Continuing to innovate and support growers worldwide.
